newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Aug manufacture input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Aug manufacture input prices fall.

text.p: The prices of materials used in Australian manufacturing fell 0.1 percent in August from the previous month and stood 4.5 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
"Lower prices for sheep and further price falls for wheat and milk were the main contributors to the fall in the manufacturing division index," the bureau said.
But it said the overall decrease was partly offset by price increases for crude oil and metal ores, together with price increases for a variety of imported materials.
It attributed this to a fall in the value of the Australian dollar against the major trading currencies.
On an annual basis, it was the first rise in manufacturing input prices since January.
